Contributors: Tanner, Henry Schenck, 1786-1858, cartographer, publisher
Includes table of distances, table of statistics, and inset map of roads from Vera Cruz and Alvarado to Mexico.

LC copy imperfect: Lacks cover. Separated into two sheets vertically along the centerfold with minor loss between the sheets, and mounted on cloth backing. Small hole in the upper right area of the sheet at the location of the Alabama River on the map.
